tasks.subject: [canvas-recovery-timeout] [P1] Bound the three identity-hold recovery tests
tasks.description:
Edit only `apps/server/src/services/canvas/doc-channel/__tests__/pump-recovery-authority.test.ts`. Import `loadCeilingMs` from `@dorkos/shared/test-budget`. In the first `it.each(['pending', 'in_doubt', 'failed'] as const)` under `accepted pump source-aware recovery refusal` (line 79 at the pinned baseline), insert `{ timeout: loadCeilingMs(5_000) }` between the unchanged title and callback. Vitest 4.1.11 accepts options in the second position. The helper currently gives a fixed 20,000 ms per-case ceiling. Leave the second group with the same parameter array, all other cases, dependencies, shared policy, and production code untouched.

Keep all fixture and assertion lines intact, including admission, the three durable SQLite intent states, retryable refusal, retained receipt/queue/staged context/batch/events, hold removal without a canonical alias, the existing fixture clock advance, the dual-pump race, no send before turn close, one nudge and one send, staged context delivery, durable settlement, and empty queue and staged rows. Preserve all waits and teardown. No new test, credential, network access, artificial load, retry or CI policy change is required.

The original file blob is `3cfaf287c380ac1b2ae6570843298313e6f9adf8` on DOR-4534 candidate `cdd77fdb71e3aed4d714dba2a75328f22680e01d` and published baseline `8ee317547876f16ded66d271016c515e88e14fe0`. Full DOR-4534 verification exited 1 with 47,635 server tests passing; the only failure was the in_doubt case at the 5,000 ms timeout (5,660 ms elapsed). The separate guarded exact-candidate replay passed 14/14 with the same case at 431 ms. The timing excursion's exact cause remains unresolved.

Inspect the exact source diff to confirm the import and options are the only implementation edits. Check formatting and whitespace. Run the entire file under the normal admitted offline test path using `pnpm exec vitest run --project server --maxWorkers=1 --retry=0 apps/server/src/services/canvas/doc-channel/__tests__/pump-recovery-authority.test.ts`. Record exact source identity, command, actual exit, all 14 cases, and times for the three affected statuses. Separately obtain actual ordinary full repository verification on the final implementation candidate with standard admission and concurrency, and record exact source identity, exit and server census. An isolated result is evidence for that run; preserve any pending or failed full verification explicitly. Capture the unfinished phase before another timeout-policy edit if a case times out again.
